points.description: Hue (H): states a narrow range around 0/360 degrees (red has hue 0). Must say narrow range and red/0 (360) degrees.
points.partial_credit: Gives hue near 0/360 (red) but does not say the range is narrow.

points.description: Saturation (S): states values close to 0.8–1 (high), because red is a primary colour and primary colours are pure colours.
points.partial_credit: Says high saturation/close to 1 but gives no reason or no 0.8–1 range.

points.description: Intensity (I): states a broad range around 0.5.
points.partial_credit: Gives about 0.5 but does not say broad range.

points.description: Uses the HSI colour model, naming all three components (Hue, Saturation, Intensity) with ranges, with no wrong extra component or wrong value.

rubric.notes: Harsh: each component needs the correct term and the right range (H narrow near 0/360, S about 0.8–1, I broad around 0.5). Vague statements such as 'red colour' alone earn nothing. A wrong value or wrong component (e.g. low saturation, narrow intensity) means that point earns nothing. Total is 2 marks.
